about_the_game:
Adversator is a fast-paced MOBA with short and intense matches.

Fight your way up the highly competitive ranked ladder or play for fun in casual matches with no waiting time.
Made by a solo indie developer with an old-school graphical touch and unique features you’ll find nowhere else.

Easy to play, easy to learn, easy to master

Despite its depth and nuances, Adversator offers a very friendly learning curve.
Forget the overcomplicated and restrictive rules, in Adversator, everything is straightforward: you’ll enjoy it immediately!

No fixed lane roles

There are no rules for the laning phase , you can go solo or push as a full team.
Adversator brings a unique philosophy to the genre: as long as you fight, do what you want !

High-intensity PvP battles

The map is carefully designed to maximize player action.
Expect fights everywhere, anytime.
No more farming, no more waiting, just pure combat!

Competition for every skill level

Because a player’s ladder position doesn’t always reflect his true level, Adversator features an advanced matchmaking system.
You’ll face opponents of all kinds and playstyles,  get ready for surprises!

For the hardcore competitors

Climb the leaderboard, be at the first of the season, and carve your name in stone for eternity!

Instant action in casual mode

In Adversator’s casual mode, you can leave anytime without penalty, restart instantly, or jump into another match whenever you want. The freedom is total !

Indie development, awesome community

Adversator has all the qualities of a passionate indie project:
- A developer who’s active and listening.
- An amazing community.
Join us and be part of the adventure!
